reasons: Claimed status is compliant and, consistent with that, the finding proposes no redline and no counterparty comment — the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 2.1(b)/(d) transfers of Additional Receivables are condition-based with consideration tied to receivables actually acquired, so no minimum volume is imposed on the Issuer/Depositor.

Acquisition Account and Negative Carry Account funding (Sections 4.4(d)(i) and 4.4(c)(i)) is expressly made by the Class A Certificateholder 'solely at its option', and the Article VIII Optional Acquisition/Clean-Up Redemption is an option, not an obligation — neither is take-or-pay against us.

The only 'shortfall' language (Section 4.3(h) Credit Payments) runs in our favour, obliging the Marketing Agent/Originator to deposit funds, correctly excluded under the rule's guidance that commitments made to us are fine.

Rationale correctly notes the $425,000 Additional Successor Servicer Fee floor is a servicing-transition fee, not a purchase commitment, so it is not a MINCOMMIT deviation; no deterministic check failures and no over-flagging.
